description:
Barmoney, Ballyhogue is a most impressive dormer style home set on a fantastic site of approx 1.3 acres. Nicely set back from the roadway with mature trees for added privacy and large rear garden space with detached garage, this is one not to be overlooked. 

The large inviting entrance hall feeds to living room, kitchen with dining room off to the rear, guest wc and downstairs bedroom. There is also a well designed sunroom and utility on the ground floor. The first floor offers a master suite with bedroom, walk in wardrobe and ensuite, two additional bedrooms and family bathroom all set off the open landing area which is light filled from overhead sky lights flooding the area in natural light.
Located just 6kms from Adamstown village offering, shop, petrol station, church, both primary and secondary school, while also just 15kms from Wexford town offering access to a wide variety of amenities. 

Early viewing is highly recommended.
